messages:
zoe (pr): Heads-up: an analyst from IDC asked for a 1-line CEO quote + embargo time. Said they might run a short ‘preview’ if we provide a line.

matt (content): Our plan: blog + benchmark drops at 10:00 PT tomorrow. No advance numbers.

irie (legal): We can approve a neutral line. I need to sign off on wording; can do quick review if it's one sentence.

matt (content): Draft: "These benchmarks reflect our ongoing investment in reducing inference latency and per-token cost across production deployments."

soph (social-ops): Social will wait for final asset links. We can prep short copy: "New inference benchmarks — blog & deep-dive tomorrow 10:00 PT." Hold until we get final URL.

zoe (pr): Add a 1-sentence methods note for the email: "We ran end-to-end latency tests across regions with consistent routing and batch-aware execution to mirror production settings."

irie (legal): Tweak language: change "batch-aware execution" to "batch-aware execution patterns" and "production settings" to "settings commonly used by customers". Approving after that.

matt (content): Updated combined copy to send under embargo: 
```
Per embargo: Not for publication or attribution until 10:00 PT on <date>. The following quote and methodology are approved for use at embargo lift.

Quote: "These benchmarks reflect our ongoing investment in reducing inference latency and per-token cost across deployment patterns we commonly see."

Methodology: "We ran end-to-end latency tests across regions with consistent routing and batch-aware execution patterns to mirror settings commonly used by customers. Cost estimates come from tokenized workloads representative of typical production usage. Results are meant to show comparative trends rather than absolute performance for any single customer workload."
```

press-bot: :inbox_tray: Email to analyst queued (ID: 2026-03-25-IDC-04).

ceo-bot: :eyes: FYI — if outlet asks for an executive comment beyond this, escalate to exec-comm.

zoe (pr): Sending now. Requesting explicit confirmation they will hold to embargo and not publish raw tables before embargo.

press-bot: :white_check_mark: Analyst acknowledged and confirmed they will hold to embargo.

soph (social-ops): Noted. Putting social drafts on hold; prepping suggested GIFs and shortened headline options.

matt (content): Thanks  if anyone hears of an outlet pushing to run early, tag this thread and we’ll loop in exec-comm.

zoe (pr): Closing thread unless we get pickup. Will reopen if we hear back or if embargo changes.
